content.text:
I fixed it: `frai gate init --ci` now creates `.github/workflows/rai-gate.yml`. I rebuilt with `pnpm --filter frai build` and ran it in an empty folder, and it created both `FRAI-SPEC.md` and the workflow file.

**Cause:** the top-level `frai` command has its own `--ci` option. By default the command-line library (Commander) lets top-level options appear anywhere on the line, even after a subcommand. So it took `--ci` for itself, and `gate` only passed `init` on to `frai-gate`. No error was shown because the flag counted as valid.
